top_signals.title: Gold Set for Longest Losing Streak Since May on AI, Fed Fears
top_signals.summary: Gold fell for a fourth straight day as a hawkish Federal Reserve pushed the dollar and Treasury yields higher, while an unraveling of AI trade forced investors to sell the precious metal to raise cash.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Anthropic Jumps 17% in Record IPO as Broader Tech Market Sells Off | Closing Bell
top_signals.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Ed Ludlow, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
